progress.command:
set -e
git switch -c chore/85-upgrades
npm install jiti@^2.7.0 @types/node@^26.6.6 oxlint-tsgolint@7.0.2007 --save-exact=false 2>&1 | tail -5
git grep -l -E "checkout@v6|setup-node@v6" -- .github action.yml README.md docs | xargs sed -i -e 's#actions/checkout@v6#actions/checkout@v7#g' -e 's#actions/setup-node@v6#actions/setup-node@v7#g'
sed -i 's#github:cv/pit\#v0.36.5#github:cv/pit\#v0.37.0#' .github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml docs/extensions.md
git diff --stat; git diff package.json; npm outdated || true
